facts.text: Descent Stage Wreckage was deployed at Jezero Crater during Perseverance (Mars 2020) in 2021.

Like Curiosity, Perseverance was lowered to the surface by a sky crane. The descent stage then flew 700 metres away and crashed. HiRISE orbital images show the dark debris field. Perseverance's cameras captured the first video of a Mars landing, showing the parachute deployment, heat shield separation, and sky crane sequence in stunning detail.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Perseverance's EDL cameras captured the first-ever video of a Mars landing, providing engineering data that will improve future landings.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Jezero Crater.
The debris field is visible from orbit; the landing video became one of the most-watched space exploration videos in history.
